Looking at panel A, the three sigmoidal F/F₀‑vs‑voltage curves (ASAP1, ASAP2s, ASAP3) are spread apart at the most negative voltages and converge to a common crossing point as voltage increases. Tracing the curves, they all meet in the region just to the right of the −100 mV tick, i.e., between −100 and 0 mV, after which they begin to separate again (with ASAP3 falling lowest at positive voltages).

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
